summary: Verbatim-first local memory with scoped namespaces (MemPalace: store exact text, never summarize on write; wings/rooms/drawers scopes; pluggable retrieval backend contract; temporal knowledge graph with validity windows; auto-save hooks and per-message verbatim sweep; canonical-source discipline) + learn-not-just-recall memory (Hindsight: retain/recall/reflect triad; world facts/experiences/observations/mental models; observations with evidence quotes and proof counts refined not overwritten; mental models as standing answers and pages as living wiki docs; decision models as typed judgments; isolated memory banks with disposition traits; memory defense scanning every retain for secrets/PII; multilingual-by-default storage) + dual-layer token classification (ERC-6960: mainId asset category, subId class/variation, two levels only; used as a classification scheme for RWA asset records, not a contract; allowance-race, reentrancy, batch-gas, and overflow notes as design checks). Patterns restated in our own words only; no code, no network/wallet/signing/payment/API-key code, no benchmark, performance, star-count, or deployment claims as fact.
